import csv
import re
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path

# Parse invoice data from PDFs
invoices = {}

# Invoice 002071 - Delta Studio Supply
invoices['002071'] = {
    'vendor': 'Delta Studio Supply',
    'items': [
        {'description': 'Archive cartons, reinforced - batch 2', 'quantity': '9', 'unit_price': '12.45', 'line_amount': '112.05'},
        {'description': 'Labels "Handle with care", roll 2', 'quantity': '3', 'unit_price': '10.80', 'line_amount': '32.40'},
        {'description': 'Cut-to-length protective liner, grade 2', 'quantity': '2.5', 'unit_price': '14.76', 'line_amount': '36.90'},
        {'description': 'Returned labels credit, order 2', 'quantity': '1', 'unit_price': '-9.80', 'line_amount': '-9.80'},
    ],
    'tax': '22.17',
    'printed_total': '193.72'
}

# Invoice 002082 - Elm Fabrication Ltd (2 pages)
invoices['002082'] = {
    'vendor': 'Elm Fabrication Ltd',
    'items': [
        {'description': 'Bench assembly, series 2', 'quantity': '2', 'unit_price': '1262.60', 'line_amount': '2525.20'},
        {'description': 'Alignment service, station 2', 'quantity': '1.5', 'unit_price': '86.40', 'line_amount': '129.60'},
        {'description': 'Replacement seal kit for hydraulic assembly, series 2, including mounting collars and protective sleeves; compatible with the extended housing and supplied with inspection certificate', 'quantity': '3', 'unit_price': '49.75', 'line_amount': '149.25'},
        {'description': 'Precision shims, pack 2', 'quantity': '7', 'unit_price': '4.375', 'line_amount': '30.63'},
        {'description': 'Freight and handling, zone 2', 'quantity': '1', 'unit_price': '42.50', 'line_amount': '42.50'},
        {'description': 'Volume discount, agreement 2', 'quantity': '1', 'unit_price': '-36.00', 'line_amount': '-36.00'},
    ],
    'tax': '154.28',
    'printed_total': '2995.46'
}

# Invoice 002093 - Firth Survey Services (2 pages)
invoices['002093'] = {
    'vendor': 'Firth Survey Services',
    'items': [
        {'description': 'Site survey, area 2', 'quantity': '1', 'unit_price': '448.50', 'line_amount': '448.50'},
        {'description': 'Travel time, route 2', 'quantity': '2.25', 'unit_price': '64.80', 'line_amount': '145.80'},
        {'description': 'Calibration standard, set 2', 'quantity': '2', 'unit_price': '37.25', 'line_amount': '74.50'},
        {'description': 'Additional sensor mounts, revised scope 2', 'quantity': '4', 'unit_price': '18.95', 'line_amount': '75.80'},
        {'description': 'Cable assemblies, shielded, length 2 m', 'quantity': '5', 'unit_price': '11.40', 'line_amount': '57.00'},
        {'description': 'Previously billed visit credit, ticket 2', 'quantity': '1', 'unit_price': '-26.00', 'line_amount': '-26.00'},
    ],
    'tax': '90.64',
    'printed_total': '866.26'
}

# Write items.csv
with open('items.csv', 'w', newline='') as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f)
    writer.writerow(['invoice_id', 'vendor', 'description', 'quantity', 'unit_price', 'line_amount'])
    
    for invoice_id in sorted(invoices.keys()):
        vendor = invoices[invoice_id]['vendor']
        for item in invoices[invoice_id]['items']:
            writer.writerow([
                invoice_id,
                vendor,
                item['description'],
                item['quantity'],
                item['unit_price'],
                item['line_amount']
            ])

# Calculate reconciliation
reconciliation = []

for invoice_id in sorted(invoices.keys()):
    invoice = invoices[invoice_id]
    
    # Calculate subtotal from line items
    subtotal = Decimal('0')
    for item in invoice['items']:
        subtotal += Decimal(item['line_amount'])
    
    tax = Decimal(invoice['tax'])
    printed_total = Decimal(invoice['printed_total'])
    computed_total = subtotal + tax
    difference = computed_total - printed_total
    
    status = 'matched' if difference == 0 else 'discrepancy'
    
    reconciliation.append({
        'invoice_id': invoice_id,
        'subtotal': str(subtotal),
        'tax': str(tax),
        'printed_total': str(printed_total),
        'computed_total': str(computed_total),
        'difference': str(difference),
        'status': status
    })

# Write reconciliation.csv
with open('reconciliation.csv', 'w', newline='') as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f)
    writer.writerow(['invoice_id', 'subtotal', 'tax', 'printed_total', 'computed_total', 'difference', 'status'])
    
    for rec in reconciliation:
        writer.writerow([
            rec['invoice_id'],
            rec['subtotal'],
            rec['tax'],
            rec['printed_total'],
            rec['computed_total'],
            rec['difference'],
            rec['status']
        ])

print("Extraction complete!")
print("\nReconciliation Summary:")
for rec in reconciliation:
    print(f"Invoice {rec['invoice_id']}: {rec['status']}")
    if rec['status'] == 'discrepancy':
        print(f"  Difference: {rec['difference']}")
EOF
